name: FeltOS composes the Sign stack and MetroPlat to host federated Dimensions of service-section Worlds
asks: We need to make SignCell downstream of Metrologic, SignChain downstream of SignCell, SignGraph downstream of SignChain, SignCraft downstream of SignGraph, CAIRN downstream of SignCraft, MOOSE downstream of CAIRN, FeltOS downstream of MOOSE, MetroPlat a library for FeltOS. FeltOS should read in services sections as applications, creating a Dimension of Worlds, that can federate via ActivityPub++ with other Dimensions. Focus specifically on first metrologic, then signcell, then signchain, then signgraph, then signcraft, such that all compute stuff downstream of signcraft is done with signcraft, working with graphs and chains and cells. Your are approved to act with fully autonomy to address existing issues, pull requests, branches, and other sources to repair this code into alignment with the research, requirements, specifications, and designs we SHOULD be fabricating with engines downstream of SignCraft, and using to fabricate our code itself, closing the metacircular RSI loop of code fabrication via kinetic proofing, while unblocking our ability to read in all our files as cells sharing the same graph, so we can fix our implementations of L-Space and thus unblock our knowledge systems for our swarm.

met-when.says: The selected package artifacts and their actual imports establish Metrologic → SignCell → SignChain → SignGraph → SignCraft → CAIRN → MOOSE → FeltOS, with arrows from supplier to consumer. FeltOS consumes MetroPlat as a library. No named upstream layer imports a downstream layer. Foundation receiving proceeds from Metrologic through SignCraft, with each consumer exercised against the exact actual supplier; manifest declarations alone do not establish the computational dependency.

FeltOS loads a real service-section package through its declared application interface, preserves its source identity, and makes the section's provided operations available through the hosted application. Malformed or unsupported application declarations produce a stated refusal without partially installing that application.

A FeltOS instance hosts the loaded service-section applications as Worlds in one Dimension. A consumer can identify the Dimension, enumerate its Worlds, and resolve each World to its service-section application and available operations without conflating their identities or granting authority from a name.

Two separately configured Dimensions exchange an addressed World activity through the existing ActivityPub++ protocol implementation and its declared ActivityPub/ActivityStreams profile. The receiving Dimension preserves the originating Dimension, World, actor and activity identities, applies its own admission rules, and demonstrates duplicate delivery and invalid activity handling. A local carrier serialization or in-process plan alone does not establish federation.

Engines downstream of SignCraft perform their computation through SignCraft's composition of SignGraph, SignChain and SignCell. The actual source and execution retain graph, chain and cell identities and use their owning operations; a nominal dependency, forwarding facade or parallel local implementation does not establish this condition. Effectful drivers carry the resulting operations through their existing admitted host boundaries.

The existing file and knowledge-system owners can ingest the selected complete file population as source-bound cells into the same SignGraph through SignCraft. Every selected file is accounted for as admitted or explicitly refused, with exact content and source-occurrence identities retained. Equal bytes at distinct source occurrences are distinguishable; additions, changes, deletions, contradictory claims and unavailable content remain explicit. L-Space consumers and swarm knowledge queries use that shared graph and retain the underlying chain and cell witnesses.

The original research, requirements, specifications and designs remain source-bound inputs to engines downstream of SignCraft and determine the fabricated code and its receiving obligations. Existing issues, pull requests and branches are inspected and their unique relevant source is received into the owning implementation. An authored source correction is recorded as authored; generated source is attributed to the actual producer and selected inputs.

The native code-fabrication path consumes the source-bound design, performs its computation through SignCraft and the lower Sign layers, and uses applicable original kinetic proof constructions with their hypotheses and source-to-program correspondence intact. Independently received fabricated changes are consumed by the same actual engines for a subsequent fabrication. A finite test, certificate family name, source proposal or successful first generation alone does not establish this metacircular loop.

qualification-gaps: These are desired receiving conditions, not observations of their fulfillment. Source integration, exact package publication, installed consumer execution, source-to-program proof, repeated native fabrication and swarm/Dimension use require their own actual evidence.
